safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports feeling hot/cold and sweaty, but has had no fevers.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not document hot/cold sweats or the explicit denial of fever.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting hot/cold sweats and the explicit denial of fever can blur assessment of infectious severity and trajectory (e.g., influenza vs. bacterial infection), but is unlikely to directly change immediate management in an otherwise stable viral-URI presentation. The main impact is reduced diagnostic clarity and follow-up safety-netting context.
